d: Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra's highly anticipated magnum opus Ramayana: Part 1 has finally hit the big screen with an astronomical Franchise budget of ₹4,000 crore and Hollywood-standard visual effects powered by 8-time Oscar-winning DNEG. Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Rocking Star Yash as the formidable Ravana, and Sai Pallavi as Sita, the film attempts to redefine Indian cinematic scale from the Devasura Sangram to the battle-ready skies of Lanka. In this detailed and honest movie review, we break down whether the global music collaboration between Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman…
